title: Neon Nightfall
summary: A neon‑lit alley chase with a hovering drone, rain‑slick walls, and a flashing billboard. The video drives a synth‑wave Minimax bed with drops for drone swoop and billboard flash.
visualArc: Drone darts past runner → rain‑slick chase → billboard flash freezes action → siren rise → chase resumes into high‑energy chorus.
